text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. One common type is supervised learning, where the computer uses labeled training data to build a model. This training data includes examples with known answers, such as photos of cats labeled "cat." The model learns patterns from these examples and then makes predictions on new, unseen data. For instance, after seeing many cat photos, the model can guess whether a new photo contains a cat. The accuracy of the model measures how often its predictions are correct. Better training data and more examples usually lead to higher accuracy, making the model more reliable.
